steps.title: Foreign Key Table-Table Joins
steps.text: Standard joins require matching keys. FK joins let you join tables by a non-key field, like joining Orders (keyed by OrderId) with Customers (keyed by CustomerId) using the Order's CustomerId field.

steps.title: Processor Lifecycle Hooks
steps.text: The IProcessorLifecycle interface provides OnInit and OnClose hooks for managing external resources like HTTP clients and database connections. The ShutdownOrchestrator closes nodes in reverse-topological order.

steps.title: Per-Processor Metrics
steps.text: Each processor node tracks records in/out, processing latency, and error counts via OpenTelemetry. State stores expose put, get, and delete latencies plus entry counts for capacity monitoring.

steps.title: Backpressure and Flow Control
steps.text: BackpressureBuffer uses System.Threading.Channels to bound internal buffers between nodes. High and low watermarks prevent oscillation, and three strategies (Block, DropOldest, DropNewest) handle buffer-full conditions.

steps.title: Retry with Backoff
steps.text: The WithRetry API adds configurable retry logic for processors that call external services. Four backoff strategies are available: Fixed, Linear, Exponential, and ExponentialWithJitter to prevent thundering herd.
